description: This file implements gap analysis logic for competencies within a role-based system, including functions to compare user assessments against role requirements, fetch competency data, and produce gap reports.

classes.name: GapItem
classes.description: Data class representing a gap in competency levels, including the competency id, name, current level, and required level.

classes.name: GapAnalysisRequest
classes.description: Schema representing the input request containing target role and current competencies for gap analysis.

classes.name: GapAnalysisResult
classes.description: Schema representing the output of the gap analysis, including target role, current competencies, and identified gaps.

classes.name: AssessedCompetency
classes.description: Schema for each assessed competency with proficiency level information.

methods.name: GapAnalysisResult analyze_gaps(session: AsyncSession, payload: GapAnalysisRequest)
methods.description: Main function to analyze competency gaps between current assessments and role requirements.

methods.name: int _score(level: str | int | None)
methods.description: Helper to convert competency level strings or integers into numeric scores for comparison.

methods.name: Dict[str,Competency] _get_competency_lookup(session: AsyncSession, ids: List[str])
methods.description: Fetches competency objects from database given a list of competency ids.

ctags.name: _get_competency_lookup
ctags.pattern: /^async def _get_competency_lookup(session: AsyncSession, ids: List[str]) -> Dict[str, Competency]/

ctags.name: analyze_gaps
ctags.pattern: /^async def analyze_gaps(session: AsyncSession, payload: GapAnalysisRequest) -> GapAnalysisResult:$/
